title: New: TW map
text: Our Territory War plan: every zone, whose team goes where, and the fleets. Type your name in “Find a member” to see exactly where your squads go. Plus the best defense teams (graded by AhnaldT101) and who can field them.

title: Members overview: the guild roster
text: Every member with role, join date and GP. Names are colored by assessment rank — hover one for the breakdown. Newly joined and returning members are marked.

title: Reva is a required TB farm
text: Our first required farm: the Inquisitor team for the Reva special mission (any 5 of 7 at R7). See who's ready and who's close.

title: New: Missing toons for platoons
text: The toons we can't place in platoons yet, the members closest to them, and credit when you reach a requirement after joining.

title: New site layout
text: Each topic in the top bar — Daily, TB, TW, Raid, Members — now opens on our latest results, with its other pages linked right next to the title.
